digest.component_or_area: pending-binding recovery gate in outbound diff reconciliation
propositions: preview and legacy --mode dry-run passes perform remote Jira add_label and set_entity_property mutations during pending-binding recovery despite being documented as no-write
the recovery gate in run_differs._run_differs_outbound gates only on scoped_ids condition without checking the persist flag, causing unscoped no-write passes to execute real client mutations
the sibling invariant-filing gate and reconcile.py write-boundary repair gates correctly compose both persist and scoped_ids axes, making the recovery gate asymmetric with surrounding code
fixing the recovery gate requires adding ctx.persist to the condition while preserving the scoped_ids short-circuit and keeping live-pass recovery behavior unchanged
